column1: # WordDelimiterIterator's character classes, as the pinned image's own JVM
# Below 256 Lucene's iterator uses a table built from
# switches on `Character.getType`. Both are the *running JVM's* tables, so
# this is the consumer's own truth in the same way the lower-case table is
# — `docs/analysis/lucene-oak-analysis.md` §4.1 states why, and why it is a
# different Unicode version from the tokenizer's word-break tables.
# Columns: <first code point in hex>\t<last>\t<class>, as ranges of equal
# class. LOWER=1 UPPER=2 DIGIT=4 ALPHA=3 ALPHANUM=7; a code point no range
# covers is SUBWORD_DELIM=8, which is the default.
